_comment: One construct per grammar patch. Patch 0003 makes the exponent's plus
sign parse - RFC 8259 allows `exp = e [ minus / plus ] 1*DIGIT` and every
JSON parser accepts it, but upstream at the pinned sha rejects it, so an
unpatched crate fails this fixture at the first exponent below.
